sections.subhead: Rebuild or Replatform Your Store Without Losing the Google Rankings You Already Earned

body.text: Teknoppy redesigns and migrates online stores in Kochi — between Shopify, WooCommerce and custom platforms — moving products, customers and order history and mapping every URL with 301 redirects so rankings are protected. Most projects take 4-8 weeks and cost Rs. 50,000-2,00,000.

Most stores lose organic traffic during a replatform for one avoidable reason: old URLs are dropped without proper redirect mapping. We audit and map every indexed URL before launch so your established Google ranking authority transfers smoothly.

items.title: Comprehensive Data Migration
items.html: Full transfer of product catalogues, variants, imagery, customer accounts, and historical order records without manual re-entry. Moving a non-store website? See our WordPress migration services.

items.title: SEO Equity & 301 Redirect Mapping
items.text: Every indexed URL is catalogued and matched 1-to-1 with new destination URLs, preventing broken links and retaining Google PageRank.

items.title: Payment & Third-Party App Sync
items.html: Reconfiguration and stress-testing of payment gateways (UPI, cards, net banking, PayPal), tax rules, and shipping couriers. See our payment gateway integration services.

sections.intro: Our 6-step ranking preservation protocol ensures zero traffic loss during store migration:

items.text: 1. Complete Crawl: Inventory every product, category, tag, and blog URL on your current store
2. 1-to-1 Mapping: Map each legacy URL to its exact replacement using permanent 301 server redirects
3. Metadata Preservation: Carry over titles, meta descriptions, image alt attributes, and structured Product schema
4. Staging QA: Validate all redirects, canonical tags, and checkout flows on an isolated staging server
5. Search Console Handover: Generate and submit new XML sitemaps in Google Search Console immediately upon launch
6. 90-Day Rank Monitoring: Track 404 crawl errors, indexation status, keyword rankings, and organic sales daily

items.q: Will we lose our Google rankings when we migrate?
items.a: Not if the migration is planned properly. Rankings are lost when old URLs disappear without redirects. We inventory every indexed URL and map it to its new address with permanent 301 redirects before launch, so ranked pages pass their equity to the new store. Minor short-term re-crawling fluctuation is normal; permanent drops are prevented.

items.q: Can you move our store from Shopify to WooCommerce, or vice versa?
items.a: Yes, in both directions, as well as from Magento, OpenCart, Wix, and legacy custom platforms. Products, variants, imagery, customer accounts, and order history are moved across, and payment and shipping rules are re-verified before switch-over.

items.q: What happens to our apps, reviews and integrations?
items.a: We audit every app and integration currently in place, identify feature equivalents on the destination platform, and export/import product reviews where platform APIs allow. Any app feature that cannot be directly migrated is flagged prior to project kickoff.

items.q: How do you make sure Google finds the new store quickly?
items.a: We activate 301 redirects for every legacy URL, generate a clean XML sitemap, submit it via Google Search Console on launch day, and monitor crawl logs and indexing daily for the first two weeks.

items.q: Will our store be offline during the migration?
items.a: No. The new store is designed, built, and tested on an isolated staging environment while your existing store continues taking orders. The final cutover typically requires only minutes of scheduled maintenance.

items.q: How long does an ecommerce redesign or migration take?
items.a: Most projects run 4 to 8 weeks from initial audit to production launch, depending on product catalog size and the number of URLs to map.
